name: Kawai Ameri
source:
"So, since we now know each other, let me treat you with my candies."

As the female president of Kawai Construction Co., she is well-known because of her talent. But all of a sudden, she left her position and retired, with her niece taking her place. Now she is the president of the private school that [url=https://vndb.org/c41775]Sora[/url] attends, Takachiho Academy. She is the childhood sweetheart of [url=/c41669]Mito Yuuri[/url], the husband of [url=/c41668]Mito Mashiro[/url], which once makes her relationship with Mashiro a little awkward. But now she supports Mashiro, as well as her friend for years.

She loves candies and her pocket is always filled with lots of them.

[From [url=http://hikarifield.com/tayutama2_en/]English Website[/url]]
